name: Anhui Xinhua Media Co., Ltd.
summary: Anhui Xinhua Media Co., Ltd. engages in the distribution of books, newspapers, periodicals, and electronic publications in China and internationally. The company is involved in the distribution of textbooks for primary and secondary schools; wholesale and retail of audio-visual products; production of TV variety shows, TV specials, TV dramas, and TV cartoons, as well as television variety shows, special programs, TV dramas, and animated series; and book rental, production, and consulting services.
